test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

This trail is not frequently visited by hikers.

options.text: Hikers not have frequently visit this trail.
Hikers does not frequently visit this trail.
Hikers do not visit this trail frequently.
Hikers did not frequently visit this trail.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Hikers do not visit this trail frequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and we need to change it into the active form.
 
• The given sentence is written in the passive form of the Simple Present Tense.
 
• The Simple Present Tense in the passive voice has the following structure: Object + is/am/are + not + V3 + by Subject__
 
• The Simple Present Tense in the active voice has the following structure: __Subject + Do/does + not + V1 + Object__
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Passive voice - *Food is not cooked by him.*
 
• Active voice - *He does not cook food.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Correct Active Voice: *Hikers do not visit this trail frequently.*
